claims.statement: The llm-access test suite is almost entirely hermetic: all test classes except RestRedisTest run without a real server, model credentials, or Docker, using injected MapEnvironment configuration, @TempDir cache directories, and recording or Mockito-stubbed model doubles; only two configuration tests deliberately target an unreachable localhost Redis port to prove the fail-fast connection contract.

MapEnvironmentTest pins the properties that make MapEnvironment safe as a test seam: unknown keys return null with no fallback to the system environment (PATH is invisible), the source map is defensively copied at construction, toString() lists variable names but never values, and equal maps yield equal, hash-equal environments.

CacheTest exercises LocalCache directly over a @TempDir file with a MapEnvironment pinning CACHE_HIERARCHY=LOCAL and CACHE_REPLACEMENT_STRATEGY=ERROR: new entries land in the cache file after flush(), a freshly constructed instance reads them back, and objects survive a Jackson round-trip via its TestCacheKey/TestCacheParameter helpers.

Test isolation of the process-global CacheManager default instance relies on the static synchronized pair setCacheDir (which atomically installs a fresh manager so cache memoization starts empty) and resetDefaultInstance (package-private, which flushes the current default instance before nulling it); CacheManagerTest and CacheTest pair @BeforeEach setCacheDir with @AfterEach resetDefaultInstance, and the synchronization serializes installs against resets across the shared JVM.

CacheReplacementStrategyTest uses two real LocalCache instances over separate @TempDir files to pin conflict semantics: NONE returns the primary value and leaves conflicting layers untouched while backfilling values missing on one side in either direction (including deep-equal distinct objects); ERROR throws IllegalStateException for a deepEquals-mismatched non-null pair but tolerates null-vs-non-null and identical content; OVERWRITE overwrites the secondary with the primary on conflict and otherwise backfills; and the deprecated resolveViaInternalKey path is covered with the same expectations.

CacheManagerTest pins the manager lifecycle and configuration: getDefaultInstance throws IllegalStateException before a directory is set; getCache rejects null arguments, memoizes by name, and rejects the same name with non-equal parameters; colons are sanitized to double underscores in file names; the explicit constructor rejects an empty hierarchy and a non-directory path; invalid CACHE_HIERARCHY or CACHE_REPLACEMENT_STRATEGY values throw IllegalArgumentException while unset variables fall back to defaults; and passesEnvironmentToRedisCache proves connection settings come from the injected environment by expecting a JedisConnectionException naming redis://127.0.0.1:1 at the first getCache.

HierarchicalCacheTest verifies the layer-synchronization contract with pure Mockito mocks (both cache layers and the CacheParameter, under Strictness.LENIENT) and no Redis or Docker: put writes through to both layers, containsKey is true when either layer holds the key and false when neither does, and flush flushes both; conflict resolution is deliberately left to CacheReplacementStrategyTest and RestRedisTest.

Chat tests run offline: CachingChatModelTest drives CachingChatModel with a RecordingChatModel implementing only ChatModel.doChat to assert each overload computes once and repeats are served from cache with zero further delegate calls after a manager reload; ChatModelUtilsTest does the same for cachedRequest/nCachedRequest with a Mockito ChatModel (n model calls on the first n-fold request, verifyNoInteractions after reload, IllegalArgumentException for non-positive counts); and LazyChatModelTest uses a counting supplier plus a reflection check that LazyChatModel overrides every non-static ChatModel method.

ChatModelProviderTest and ChatConfigurationTest inject all credentials through MapEnvironment so results never depend on the developer's .env or system environment: createChatModel returns a LazyChatModel (the platform client is never constructed in tests) and throws IllegalStateException for every platform when the required credential is missing; ChatConfigurationTest also pins the default seed and temperature and the temperature-omitting cache file identifier gpt-4o_133742243.

CachedEmbeddingCreatorTest drives a recording CachedEmbeddingCreator subclass whose EmbeddingModel is a Mockito stub counting embed calls and returning a deterministic first-character vector, verifying single-computation caching, input-order preservation, the empty-input short-circuit, persistence across a cache reload, the parallel path's per-thread model construction with forwarded parameters, and that the constructor-injected environment is visible inside createEmbeddingModel; EmbeddingConfigurationTest covers the configuration API including the fresh SystemEnvironment builder default and the MOCK platform needing no model name.

RestRedisTest is the suite's single integration test, gated by @Testcontainers(disabledWithoutDocker = true) so mvn verify skips it automatically without Docker; with Docker it starts a redis:latest container, launches an in-JVM org.fuchss rest-redis Server thread on a free port in front of it, polls GET / for readiness within 30 seconds, and injects REST_REDIS_URI plus empty REST_REDIS_USERNAME/REST_REDIS_PASSWORD through a MapEnvironment before exercising RestRedisCache and HierarchicalCache.

RestRedisTest covers the deployed topology end to end, including all three CacheReplacementStrategy behaviors over a real local + REST-Redis HierarchicalCache pair: the connection via Cache.createByType(CacheType.REST_REDIS, ...), set/get with null for missing keys, NONE returning the primary local value and leaving the Redis value unchanged, OVERWRITE overwriting the Redis value after flush(), ERROR throwing an IllegalStateException whose message contains 'Cache inconsistency', and backfill of a Redis-only value into the local layer on flush().

NoGlobalEnvironmentTest is an ArchUnit suite analyzing all non-test classes under edu.kit.kastel.mcse.ardoco.llm that enforces the no-global-environment invariant with two rules: noStaticEnvironmentFields forbids any static field whose type is assignable to EnvironmentProvider because 'environments must be injected, not shared globally', and defaultCacheManagerOnlyInConvenienceOverload forbids CacheManager.getDefaultInstance() calls from every origin except EmbeddingCreator.create(EmbeddingConfiguration) because 'the cache manager (and with it the cache environment) must be injected'.

The ArchUnit rules make the invariant build-enforced rather than conventional: the compiler would accept a static EnvironmentProvider field or a stray getDefaultInstance() call, but mvn verify fails on them; the single sanctioned call site short-circuits the MOCK platform before delegating to create(configuration, CacheManager.getDefaultInstance()).

CacheTest.testBackwardCompatibility guards LiSSA cache-format compatibility by copying the checked-in fixture src/test/resources/cache/test-local-cache-sample.json (a flat JSON object mapping KeyGenerator content UUIDs to plain unserialized string values) into the temp cache directory and reading all three entries back by their content strings, exercising both the content-UUID localKey derivation and Cache.convert's raw-string fallback for legacy unserialized values.

KeyGeneratorTest.stableUuidValue pins KeyGenerator.generateKey(test) to 098f6bcd-4621-3373-8ade-4e832627b4f6 because the generated keys are part of the on-disk cache format and must remain stable so existing cache files keep resolving; the same class pins determinism, CRLF-to-LF normalization, distinct inputs yielding distinct keys, and IllegalArgumentException for null input.

The backward-compatible cache file identifier is pinned in the key tests: ChatCacheKeyTest asserts ChatCacheParameter.parameters() omits the temperature component when it is 0.0 (gpt-4o_42) and includes it otherwise (gpt-4o_42_0.5), and EmbeddingCacheKeyTest.ofRawCustomLocalKey guards that the deprecated EmbeddingCacheKey.ofRaw preserves a custom local key used by the long-text embedding recovery path.
mvn verify is the documented full build-and-test gate; the Testcontainers-based RestRedisTest skips automatically when no Docker environment is available, so the gate runs on machines without Docker.

The verify.yml CI workflow delegates to the shared ardoco/actions maven.yml workflow with deploy=false, with-submodules=true, and ubuntu-latest, triggering on pushes to main (ignoring v* tags) and on PRs opened/synchronize/reopened, with paths-ignore for docs/** and openwiki/** so documentation-only changes do not trigger builds.

Formatting is gated by Spotless with the Eclipse profile in formatter.xml and the import order in spotless.importorder (java, javax, org, com); the format.yml workflow runs on PRs to main and manually, derives the JDK version from the POM, runs mvn -B spotless:apply --file pom.xml, and auto-commits the result via stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action as 'Apply formatting changes', so formatting differences are applied automatically rather than blocking review.
